verdict.rationale: The docs say a named Bot keeps its memory and preferences across sessions, and a Bot is set up by describing its job in a message, so it has persistent per-Bot context. Community users report that each bot keeps its own context and memory. But nothing documents a dedicated custom-instructions or system-prompt setting, or says how preferences shape every response. Missing for 10: an explicit editable custom-instructions or system-prompt feature, documentation that preferences apply to every response, and hands-on confirmation that set preferences reliably persist.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response

citations.quote: A named Bot keeps its memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions instead of resetting on every task.
Create a Bot, describe the job, and grant access as it asks.
each bot owns its own routines, context and domain
